name: _private.PrimeCert.ForMathlib.0.Nat.modEq_finset_prod_iff
statement:
theorem Nat.modEq_finset_prod_iff {a b : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (e : ι → ℕ)
    (co : (s : Set ι).Pairwise (Coprime.onFun e)) :
    a ≡ b [MOD ∏ i ∈ s, e i] ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, a ≡ b [MOD e i]

name: _private.PrimeCert.PowMod.0.powModK_aux_eq
statement:
lemma powModK_aux_eq (n a b c fuel) (hfuel : b < fuel) :
    powModK.aux n fuel a b c = powModAux a b c n

name: _private.PrimeCert.PowMod.0.powModK_aux_succ_eq
statement:
lemma powModK_aux_succ_eq {n a b c fuel : ℕ} :
    powModK.aux n (fuel + 1) a b c =
      (b.beq 0).rec (true := c % n)
      (((b % 2).beq 0).rec
        (powModK.aux n fuel (a * a % n) (b / 2) (a * c % n))
        (powModK.aux n fuel (a * a % n) (b / 2) c))

name: _private.PrimeCert.PowMod.0.powModK_aux_succ_eq'
statement:
lemma powModK_aux_succ_eq' {n a b c fuel : ℕ} :
    powModK.aux n (fuel + 1) a b c =
      if b = 0 then c % n else
      if b % 2 = 0 then powModK.aux n fuel (a * a % n) (b / 2) c
      else powModK.aux n fuel (a * a % n) (b / 2) (a * c % n)

name: _private.PrimeCert.PowMod.0.powModK_aux_zero_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma powModK_aux_zero_eq {n a b c : ℕ} :
    powModK.aux n 0 a b c = 0

name: _private.PrimeCert.ForallB.0.PrimeCert.forallB_succ
statement:
@[simp, grind =] theorem forallB_succ (f : ℕ → Bool) (start len step : ℕ) :
    forallB f start (len + 1) step =
      (f ((len.mul step).add start)).and (forallB f start len step)

name: _private.PrimeCert.ForallB.0.PrimeCert.forallB_zero
statement:
@[simp, grind =] theorem forallB_zero (f : ℕ → Bool) (start step : ℕ) :
    forallB f start 0 step = true

name: _private.PrimeCert.Pocklington.0.PocklingtonPred.zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem PocklingtonPred.zero {N root : ℕ} :
    PocklingtonPred N root 0

name: _private.PrimeCert.Pocklington3.0.Nat.modEq_iff_exists_mul_add'
statement:
theorem Nat.modEq_iff_exists_mul_add' {p q b : ℕ} (hqp : q ≤ p) :
    p ≡ q [MOD b] ↔ ∃ k, k * b + q = p

name: _private.PrimeCert.Pocklington3.0.PrimeCert.Pocklington3Cert.of_prime
statement:
theorem Pocklington3Cert.of_prime (r s p : Nat) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (h2p : 2 < p)
    (cond : (r ^ 2 - 8 * s) ^ (p / 2) % p = p - 1) :
    Pocklington3Cert r s

name: _private.PrimeCert.Pocklington3.0.PrimeCert.Pocklington3CertMode.to_cert
statement:
theorem Pocklington3CertMode.to_cert (m : Pocklington3CertMode) (r s : ℕ) (h : m.calculate r s) :
    Pocklington3Cert r s

name: _private.PrimeCert.Pocklington3.0.PrimeCert.PrimePow.toNat_def
statement: @[simp] theorem PrimePow.toNat_def (pp : PrimePow) : pp.toNat = pp.prime ^ pp.pow

name: _private.PrimeCert.Pocklington3.0.PrimeCert.mem_primeFactors_prod_toNat
statement:
theorem mem_primeFactors_prod_toNat (L : List PrimePow) (p : ℕ) :
    p ∈ (L.map PrimePow.toNat |>.prod |>.primeFactors) → ∃ pp ∈ L, pp.prime = p

name: _private.PrimeCert.Pocklington3.0.PrimeCert.of_gcd_pred_mod_eq_one
statement:
theorem of_gcd_pred_mod_eq_one (a b : ℕ) (h : (a % b - 1).gcd b = 1)
    (hb : 2 ≤ b) : (a - 1).gcd b = 1

name: _private.PrimeCert.Pocklington3.0.PrimeCert.pocklington3_test
statement:
theorem pocklington3_test (N F R m r s : ℕ)
    (R_def : F * R + 1 = N) (r_def : R % (2 * F) = r) (s_def : R / (2 * F) = s)
    (h2n : 2 ≤ N) (odd_n : Odd N) (odd_R : Odd R)
    (primitive : ∀ p ∈ F.primeFactors, ∃ a, a ^ (N - 1) ≡ 1 [MOD N] ∧
      (a ^ ((N - 1) / p) - 1).gcd N = 1)
    (divisors : ∀ l, 1 ≤ l → l < m → ¬ l * F + 1 ∣ N)
    (bound : N + (m * F + 1) * (m * F) < (m * F + 1) * (2 * F ^ 2 + r * F + 1))
    (cert : s = 0 ∨ ¬ IsSquare (r ^ 2 - 8 * s) ∨ r ^ 2 < 8 * s) :
    Nat.Prime N
